description: Send the exact approved personal email from the authenticated business mailbox to 1–5 explicit recipients. This sends real email. First show the sender, recipient addresses, subject and full body; send only when the user explicitly authorizes that message. Selecting CRM leads or preparing meeting/booking links never authorizes sending. Use verified addresses from get_business_mail_recipients, never guess them. Requires a verified sending domain and applies the same suppression, tracking, sender name, rate and storage protections as the dashboard. Reuse the same requestId UUID for the same approved message. The response confirms provider submission, not delivery. If stored is false, report that the accepted message is missing its saved copy; do not resend. On an uncertain outcome, check Sent and clarify instead of retrying with a new ID. This is personal correspondence, not a newsletter or bulk broadcast.

approved.description: Only true after the user explicitly authorizes sending this exact message to these recipients.

draftId.description: Only when answering a received message that has a saved reply draft: its id, exactly as replyArgs gives it. Sends to that message’s sender only, clears the draft afterwards and refuses a second delivery of the same draft.

expectedDraft.description: Required with draftId: the stored draft text exactly as replyArgs gives it, so a draft the owner changed meanwhile is never sent unseen (MAIL_DRAFT_CHANGED). The body you send is text; it may be an approved edit of the draft.

from.description: The exact verified business sender address returned by get_business_mail_recipients.

inReplyTo.description: Optional original message ID for a reply; never invent it.

replyId.description: Optional exact original message ID from the owned business mailbox.

requestId.description: Stable UUID for this approved message. Reuse on retries; never change its content or recipients.

subject.description: The exact approved email subject, 1–300 characters, without line breaks.

text.description: The complete approved plain-text email body, including only guest meeting links for recipients. Never share hostJoinUrl or private CRM briefs.

to.description: 1–5 exact, reviewed recipient email addresses. Follow CRM discovery pagination before choosing a list; never silently select the first page or omit recipients to fit the limit.

trackOpens.description: Optional explicit tracking preference; omit to use the saved business setting.

name: send_business_email
